Hi Elena — thanks, got the redlines. Attaching our annotated Order Form + a short note on proposed language to try to meet NovaCorp's privacy needs without blocking standard case-study outcomes.

Quick summary of our thinking:
- Confidentiality / Sensitive Configs: we can accept a carve-out that prevents disclosure of specific configuration details or PII, but we need the right to describe the business outcome and high-level architecture (no raw logs or screenshots).
- Press review window: happy to commit to a 30-day review, but request a single-point redline (one consolidated set of comments) to avoid iterative cycles.
- Anonymized references: we can add an option for "anonymized reference" where we publish aggregate metrics without naming NovaCorp — requires a checkbox on the Order Form so sales/marketing can track which customers need anonymity.

Kimberly / Naomi — can you take a look at Elena's redlines and the draft publicity_clauses_proposed_text.txt I attached and advise on whether the proposed Order Form checkbox and the anonymized-reference wording are legally sound?

Elena / procurement@novacorp.com — if you can confirm the desire for a single consolidated review set and whether NovaCorp requires embargo/notice dates tied to external events, we can aim to circulate a final redline this afternoon.

Thanks,
Sean

Elena / Sean — I reviewed the redlines. High level guidance and proposed edits below (see attached NOVACORP_MSA_redline_v2.docx for tracked changes):

- Confidentiality carve-out: Acceptable if the clause is narrowly tailored. Proposed text: "Customer Confidential Information shall not include non-identifying, aggregate performance metrics or high-level architectural descriptions that do not disclose Customer-specific configurations or PII." This preserves our ability to speak to outcomes without exposing configuration details.

- Press/Review window: We can accept 30 days with a "single consolidated submission" requirement. Add: "Customer shall provide consolidated comments within 30 days of receipt; failure to respond shall be deemed consent." This gives us predictability.

- Anonymized reference checkbox: Good practice — add a checkbox on the Order Form that reads: "Customer consents to anonymized, aggregate references that do not identify Customer by name." If checked, Redwood may publish aggregated metrics but will not use Customer name or logo. If not checked, use of name/logo requires separate written consent per the publicity section.

- Logos and Testimonials: For any use of Customer logo or quote, keep approval tied to a scoped asset and sample text; logos will be provided via a dedicated asset link and usage will be limited to the agreed channels.

Risk notes: do not accept open-ended "any marketing mention" language. Also avoid automatic consent triggered by order activation.

Please find attached recommended tracked changes (NOVACORP_MSA_redline_v2.docx) and a short text file with the proposed Order Form checkbox wording. Happy to talk through specifics on a call if helpful.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly@godwood.com
